timing: Frozen before any heldout directory exists in the named v12 run; first QAD candidate is still training. No main or supplemental heldout outcome used to choose this reference.
research_question: Compare calibrated NVFP4 GPTQ against same-coverage RTN and the development-selected recovery models on the same fixed ten LIBERO tasks.

calibration.source: training-only successful BF16 captures from teacher_supervision partition
calibration.order: task order in teacher audit, then filename; consume every observation exactly once
calibration.fallbacks: Report aliases and non-Linear RTN fallbacks; inactive category banks use RTN. Do not label all tensors GPTQ.

quantization.weight: NVFP4 E2M1, E4M3 scale per16, FP32 secondary scale; frozen PTQ values stored dequantized in BF16
quantization.activation_qdq: same v12 installer, all eligible ordinary/category operators; secondary scale1
quantization.scope: numerical QDQ reference, not native deployment

execution.start_condition: Main v12 five-arm final manifest exists and verifies; no competing GPU process. No extra recovery training or development selection for this single fixed GPTQ recipe.

reporting_metrics.micro_success_rate: total successes divided by all episodes; used for pressure screening
reporting_metrics.task_macro_success_rate: unweighted mean of ten task success rates; primary summary

primary_effect_minimum.note: The 160 paired episodes support 10-point recovery claims as the preregistered minimum; smaller differences are exploratory.

execution.retry: Infrastructure failures use a new audited output directory with unchanged model/protocol/seeds; never retry based on score. Preserve failed attempt metadata and cost.

comparison.selection: Use exactly the original v12 development-selected checkpoints from its verified final manifest. Never replace an arm based on heldout scores.
comparison.estimand: Equal-weight mean success-rate difference across the ten fixed tasks, treatment minus baseline

confidence_interval.method: paired percentile bootstrap within each fixed task

tests.method: exact two-sided McNemar conditional on discordant paired outcomes
tests.adjustment: Holm across the three named supplementary contrasts
tests.family_scope: This is a separate, prospectively specified supplementary family. Do not claim paper-wide error control across it and the four main contrasts.
tests.assumptions: Independent discordant signs with arm exchangeability within each task; equality of the task-average rate alone does not imply this null.

comparison.interpretation: Report every contrast regardless of sign. Pointwise intervals condition on ten fixed tasks and one training seed; no unseen-task generalization, equivalence claim from a degenerate interval, or guaranteed power. Do not retune based on these results.

reporting: All six arm success rates, per-task counts, paired reset identities, gains/losses, conditional intervals and specified p-values
Physical and tied-deduplicated encoded weight budgets including scales/padding/exclusions and recovery LoRA costs
Actual calibration rows/calls, fallback methods and wall/GPU costs; windows are not independent trajectories
No claim to exceed PTQ SOTA or QVLA from GPTQ alone; no native speed claim from QDQ
source_policy: Record and verify these source identities before execution. Any bugfix requires an explicitly recorded protocol amendment before the affected supplemental measurement; no silent changes.
